With our eTrack case tracking service you can receive email updates and appearance reminders for Civil Supreme Court cases. WebCivil Supreme is provided as a FREE public service by the New York State Unified Court System. This site may not be accessed by any automated program ("bot") for the purpose of extracting data for any use. This site may not be directly linked to by any website without the express written permission of UCS.
